battle.name: 俄國-波斯戰爭
battle.brief: 俄國-波斯戰爭於一八〇四年在南高加索爆發，波斯進攻俄屬喬治亞，戰線其後延伸至亞塞拜然與亞美尼亞；輪發手槍（Wheellock pistol）於一五〇〇年列裝，是歐洲陸軍早期制式火槍之一。戰事延續至一八一三年，最終條約重新劃定兩國的高加索邊界。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 1804年的戰局沿亞美尼亞、喬治亞與亞塞拜然交界展開，主體是俄羅斯帝國對卡札爾波斯。俄方並非只帶一支俄軍：卡爾特利-卡赫季已於1801年併入俄國行政，卡爾特利與卡赫季由梯菲斯（Tbilisi，舊稱Tiflis）的軍事機關治理；伊梅列蒂在索羅門二世仍是國王時已受俄軍控制，高里與明格列里也駐有俄軍，但它們何時完成正式兼併是後續問題。因此，1804年9月的交戰通常記作俄軍與伊梅列蒂軍隊對波斯軍，而不能把每個喬治亞王國都當成享有完整主權的盟國。波斯方面由法塔利沙調集中央軍，以及亞塞拜然、耶爾溫汗國等宗主體系下的分遣隊；米爾扎穆罕默德汗率主力進入南高加索。戰線由辛納吉一帶經阿斯蘭迪推向納赫奇萬，年底再抵耶爾溫，補給與指揮距離同步拉長。
countriesEn: The 1804 campaign unfolded along the meeting point of Armenia, Georgia, and Azerbaijan, with the Russian Empire facing Qajar Persia. The Russian side brought more than a Russian army: Kartli-Kakheti had been incorporated into Russian administration in 1801, and Kartli and Kakheti were governed through the military authorities at Tbilisi, then called Tiflis. Imereti remained a kingdom under Solomon II in name but was already controlled by Russian troops, while Russian forces were also stationed in Guria and Mingrelia; the formal annexation of those western Georgian territories remained a later question. The fighting of September 1804 is therefore conventionally recorded as Russian and Imeretian troops against a Persian army, not as a coalition of fully sovereign Georgian states. Fath-Ali Shah mobilized troops from the central government together with detachments from Azerbaijan and the Erivan Khanate within the Persian sphere of suzerainty. Mirza Mohammad Khan led the main body into the Transcaucasus. The front ran from Sighnaghi through Aslandı toward Nakhchivan and reached Yerevan by the end of the year, stretching both the command and supply lines.
people: 俄方的指揮鏈以巴夫利·齊茨揚諾夫少將為核心。他以梯菲斯為軍務中心，把常備步兵營列、砲兵連、哥薩克騎兵百人隊與喬治亞分遣隊納入同一作戰計畫；巴格拉季昂少將率領前隊，負責前哨接觸、側翼機動與追擊。索羅門二世仍以伊梅列蒂國王身分組織本地步兵和輕騎，這些分隊在辛達格與阿斯蘭迪都直接參戰，並非只在後方提供糧食。波斯方面，法塔利沙決定將入侵提升為對南高加索的軍事行動，米爾扎穆罕默德汗則負責野戰指揮，集中亞塞拜然與耶爾溫方向的部隊、火砲和隨軍輜重。齊茨揚諾夫在辛達格獲勝後沒有立即把全部縱隊投入追擊，而是先確認道路、糧食和彈藥供應，再分兵處理納赫奇萬與耶爾溫；米爾扎穆罕默德汗在阿斯蘭迪退卻後也未能重新集結被切斷的先鋒與主隊。兩套指揮系統的差別，具體表現在俄軍能把步兵、砲兵、騎兵和後勤分列安排，而波斯遠征軍在離開南高加索後，其前鋒、側翼與本部之間的聯繫迅速惡化。
peopleEn: The Russian command centered on Major General Pavel Tsitsianov. Using Tiflis as his military administrative center, he brought regular infantry battalions, artillery companies, Cossack cavalry sotnias, and Georgian detachments into one operational plan. Major General Pyotr Bagration led the vanguard, conducting forward contact, flank movement, and pursuit. Solomon II continued to organize local infantry and light cavalry as king of Imereti; these formations fought directly at Shindag and Aslandı rather than serving merely as rear-area suppliers. On the Persian side, Fath-Ali Shah authorized the campaign into the Transcaucasus, while Mirza Mohammad Khan held field command and concentrated troops, artillery, and baggage columns from Azerbaijan and the Erivan direction. After the success at Shindag, Tsitsianov did not immediately throw every column into the pursuit. He first checked roads, food, and ammunition, then assigned separate forces to Nakhchivan and Yerevan. After Aslandı, Mirza Mohammad Khan could not reunite his severed vanguard with the main body. The practical difference between the two command systems was that Russia could place infantry, guns, cavalry, and logistics in a deliberate sequence, whereas the Persian expeditionary army rapidly lost cohesion between its advanced elements, flank, and center once it moved away from the Transcaucasus.
kits: 交戰雙方的裝備反映不同的軍制與作戰環境。常備俄軍步兵使用1795式燧發滑膛槍，槍上配有刺刀；步兵以腰帶藥盒攜帶定裝紙藥包，連隊再由彈藥車補充。俄軍砲兵使用六磅級輕型野戰砲，炮身、火藥、炮彈和引火器材分車運輸，火砲以炮車前車與炮架行軍，不能像步槍隊那樣快速分遣。哥薩克使用輕型騎槍、馬刀和長矛，喬治亞輕騎則以長矛、小盾和彎刀作戰；這些騎兵適合追擊、遮斷道路和攻擊暴露側翼。波斯步兵常見托番式火繩槍，部分部隊使用坦布爾式燧發槍，後者在硝煙、濕氣和短時間轉移射擊中較能保持動作；波斯騎兵配置弓箭、箭囊、長矛、小盾及弧刃彎刀，另有與部隊分列的火砲和備用彈藥。阿斯蘭迪一帶多丘陵、峽口與破碎地面，限制騎兵橫向展開，卻使居高射擊、步兵縱隊和少量定向砲火更容易發揮作用。俄軍的主要優勢是制式火槍、整齊的步兵射線以及能由梯菲斯、哥里和辛納吉接續補給的砲彈系統；波斯的長武器配置適合追擊與衝擊，但火繩槍較多使砲兵、藥包和火繩的管理更為繁複。
kitsEn: The equipment of both sides reflected different military systems and operating environments. Regular Russian infantry used the Model 1795 flintlock musket with a bayonet. Each soldier carried paper cartridges in a belt cartridge box, with company ammunition boxes and carts providing replenishment. Russian artillery used light six-pounder field guns, with gun, propellant, shot, and ignition equipment carried separately. A gun traveled with its limber and carriage and could not be detached as rapidly as an infantry formation. Cossacks used light cavalry carbines, sabers, and lances, while Georgian light cavalry fought with lances, small shields, and curved swords. These mounted troops were suited to pursuit, road interdiction, and attacks against exposed flanks. Persian infantry commonly carried tufan matchlocks, while some formations used tanbur flintlocks, which could maintain action more effectively in smoke, damp, and rapid changes of firing position. Persian cavalry had bows, quivers, lances, small shields, and curved sabers, with artillery and reserve ammunition moving separately from the main body. The broken hills, defiles, and uneven ground around Aslandı restricted broad cavalry movement but increased the value of high firing positions, infantry columns, and a limited weight of directed artillery. Russian strength lay in standardized muskets, coherent infantry fire, and an artillery system supplied through Tiflis, Gori, and Sighnaghi. The Persian configuration favored pursuit and shock, but the prevalence of matchlocks complicated the control of guns, cartridges, and slow matches.
tactics: 波斯遠征軍進入卡赫季後，先鋒試圖控制通往梯菲斯的方向。九月九日的辛達格戰鬥中，俄格聯軍利用辛納吉周邊丘陵切斷波斯先鋒與本部的聯繫；巴格拉季昂率前隊壓迫其退路，索羅門二世所率伊梅列蒂及其他喬治亞分隊從正面施加壓力，迫使波斯軍向阿斯蘭迪方向收縮。九月二十日左右，波斯主力佔據道路兩側高地與坡地，居高射擊並準備衝擊逼近的俄軍。齊茨揚諾夫到達後沒有把全部步兵一次投入正面，而是先以砲火壓制高地上的人員射線，步兵則分縱隊沿坡面之間推進；巴格拉季昂的前隊控制側翼通路，索羅門二世的輕騎留在另一側，等待波斯隊形因進攻而拉開。波斯軍正面衝擊未能切開俄軍步兵基線，俄軍縱隊隨即向兩側高地施壓，喬治亞輕騎攻擊其暴露方向並追擊退卻者。崎嶇地面、溪流和被丟下的火砲使退卻很快失去秩序，部分波斯火砲與輜重落入俄軍手中。追擊仍受到道路、彈藥和糧食的限制，齊茨揚諾夫因此沒有把戰果延伸成無節制的長距離追逐。十月以後，俄軍以分遣隊封鎖城區道路，以砲兵和步兵控制防線，接收納赫奇萬的城防與軍械庫；年底又以相同方法迫使耶爾溫防務崩解，取得城區和儲存設施。阿斯蘭迪的勝負由此轉化為兩座戰略城市的控制權，而不只是野外的單次交鋒。
tacticsEn: After entering Kakheti, the Persian expeditionary army sought to control the direction toward Tiflis. In the fighting at Shindag on 9 September, the Russian-Georgian force used the hills around Sighnaghi to disrupt the Persian connection between vanguard and main body. Bagration's advanced troops pressed the retreat while the Imeretian and other Georgian detachments under Solomon II applied pressure from the front, forcing the Persians to contract toward Aslandı. Around 20 September, the Persian main body occupied heights and slopes on both sides of the road, firing from elevation and preparing to charge the approaching Russians. Tsitsianov did not commit all infantry to a frontal assault. He first used artillery to suppress the high-ground firing line, then advanced infantry in columns between the slopes. Bagration's vanguard controlled the flanking approaches, while Solomon II's light cavalry waited on the opposite side for a Persian formation to open when it attacked. The Persian frontal charges failed to break the Russian infantry line. Russian columns then pressed against the high ground on both sides, Georgian light cavalry struck the exposed direction, and the retreat quickly lost order over broken terrain, streams, and abandoned guns. Part of the Persian artillery and baggage consequently fell into Russian hands. The pursuit remained limited by roads, ammunition, and food, so Tsitsianov did not convert the victory into an uncontrolled long march. From October, Russian detachments blocked roads around the objectives and used artillery and infantry to control the defenses, taking over Nakhchivan's fortifications and arsenal. By the end of the year, the same combination of movement, artillery pressure, and controlled advance brought the defenses of Yerevan down and secured the city and its storage facilities. The outcome at Aslandı therefore became a change in control of two strategic towns, not merely a field victory.
data: 把日曆、路線和後勤放在一起，1804年的時間線相當清楚：九月九日是辛達格戰鬥；九月十八日是阿斯蘭迪決戰，俄曆記為九月六日；其後數日是追擊與收繳火砲、輜重；新曆十月二十二日、俄曆十月十日，俄軍控制納赫奇萬；新曆十二月二十六日、俄曆十二月十四日，俄軍接管耶爾溫。俄軍主線由梯菲斯經哥里約一百五十公里至辛納吉，再以山道向東約一百五十至二百公里抵達阿斯蘭迪；阿斯蘭迪至納赫奇萬約一百五十至一百八十公里，納赫奇萬至耶爾溫約一百四十至一百六十公里。這些數字是道路距離的概略值，不是行軍日程的精確計算。秋季道路使炮架、彈藥車和傷員後送隊成為限制速度的因素，步兵、騎兵與砲兵必須分批出發，不能同時保持在一處。梯菲斯是主要軍械與後送中心，哥里、辛納吉一線則提供中繼位置；火槍藥包需由連隊補充，野戰砲的備用火藥、炮彈與附屬器材則須另行安排。波斯軍原可利用耶爾溫與納赫奇萬的倉儲，但遠征離開南高加索後，補給線越過卡爾特利與卡赫季的崎嶇道路；阿斯蘭迪戰敗後，後方輜重和部分火砲被遺失，後續攻勢更受限制。俄軍攻下納赫奇萬與耶爾溫後取得當地軍械庫，緩解了遠程補給的一部分負擔，但從梯菲斯到前線仍約有六百五十至七百公里的縱深。現有史料對逃散、追擊、受傷與被俘者的計數互不一致，因此本錄不列任何未經核實的精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: Placed together, the calendar, route, and logistics form a clear sequence for 1804. The fighting at Shindag occurred on 9 September. The decisive Battle of Aslandı followed on 18 September Gregorian, or 6 September in the Russian calendar, followed over the next several days by pursuit and the capture of guns and baggage. On 22 October Gregorian, or 10 October Old Style, the Russians took control of Nakhchivan; on 26 December Gregorian, or 14 December Old Style, they assumed control of Yerevan. The Russian axis ran from Tiflis about 150 kilometres to Gori, then by mountain track roughly 150 to 200 kilometres to Sighnaghi and onward to Aslandı. The road from Aslandı to Nakhchivan was approximately 150 to 180 kilometres, and Nakhchivan to Yerevan approximately 140 to 160 kilometres. These are approximate road distances rather than exact marching schedules. In autumn, gun carriages, ammunition wagons, and the wounded column became major constraints on speed, forcing infantry, cavalry, and artillery to move in separate stages rather than remain concentrated in one place. Tiflis served as the principal arsenal and receiving center, while Gori and Sighnaghi provided intermediate positions. Musket ammunition was replenished at company level, and reserve propellant, shot, and artillery accessories for field guns required separate arrangements. The Persian army could initially draw upon the depots at Yerevan and Nakhchivan, but once it moved into the Transcaucasus its supply line crossed the difficult roads of Kartli and Kakheti. After the defeat at Aslandı, baggage and some guns were lost, further restricting the Persian offensive. The capture of Nakhchivan and Yerevan gave the Russians access to local arsenals and reduced part of the burden of long-range supply, although the distance from Tiflis to the front still lay around 650 to 700 kilometres. Surviving accounts count losses from flight, pursuit, wounds, and captivity differently, so no unverified precise total of killed, wounded, or captured is given here.
cause: 戰爭源於俄國在喬治亞的權力擴張與波斯對北境安全及舊有勢力範圍的要求正面相撞。1783年的《格魯吉耶夫斯克條約》使卡爾特利-卡赫季接受俄國保護，1798年的俄格同盟又確認俄方在當地外交與軍事上的主導地位；1801年俄國正式把卡爾特利-卡赫季併入帝國行政，使喬治亞的國家地位成為莫斯科與德黑蘭之間的直接爭議。1802年俄軍進入伊梅列蒂，1803年前後又在高里和明格列里建立駐防，使俄軍從卡赫季向西伸出的不只是邊防哨站，而是一條能切斷波斯與高加索西部政治聯繫的走廊。法塔利沙要求俄方撤出這些地區，並把俄軍在南高加索的集結視為對波斯北部邊界的包圍；對剛完成中央集權的卡札爾王朝而言，耶爾溫汗國與亞塞拜然之間的安全距離尤其重要。俄方則把新兼併的東喬治亞省、受控的伊梅列蒂和通往南高加索的道路視為不可退讓的戰略結構，必須阻止波斯軍在西部喬治亞建立穩定據點。直接引發戰鬥的是雙方在阿拉克塞河與卡赫季一線的長期軍對峙，以及法塔利沙的撤軍要求未獲接受。米爾扎穆罕默德汗因此先行進攻，企圖在俄軍完成西部整頓前逐出梯菲斯方向的駐軍；齊茨揚諾夫則把有限的俄軍集中成一條可以作戰的正面，拒絕讓控制格魯吉亞交通線的任務因分散兵力的批評而改變。
causeEn: The war arose from the collision between Russian expansion in Georgia and Persian demands concerning northern security and the limits of earlier influence. The Treaty of Georgievsk in 1783 placed Kartli-Kakheti under Russian protection, and the Russo-Georgian alliance of 1798 confirmed Russian predominance in local diplomacy and military affairs. Russia's formal incorporation of Kartli-Kakheti into imperial administration in 1801 made the status of Georgia a direct issue between Moscow and Tehran. Russian troops entered Imereti in 1802 and established positions in Guria and Mingrelia around 1803, so the Russian presence extending west from Kakheti was no longer a chain of frontier posts but a corridor capable of separating Persia from the political connections of western Georgia. Fath-Ali Shah demanded withdrawal and regarded the Russian concentration in the Transcaucasus as an encirclement of Persia's northern frontier. For the recently centralized Qajar dynasty, the security distance between the Erivan Khanate and Azerbaijan was particularly important. Russia, in turn, regarded the annexed eastern Georgian province, controlled Imereti, and the roads into the Transcaucasus as a strategic structure that could not be surrendered. The immediate trigger was the prolonged military confrontation along the Aras and in Kakheti after the Persian demand for withdrawal was not accepted. Mirza Mohammad Khan therefore attacked first, seeking to drive Russian troops away from the western Georgian approaches before Moscow completed its consolidation. Tsitsianov concentrated the limited troops available into a single usable front and refused to alter the task of protecting the Georgian communications because of criticism that his force was too dispersed.
impact: 1804年秋季的變化首先發生在戰區控制上。阿斯蘭迪之後，波斯遠征軍被逐出卡赫季，齊茨揚諾夫得以把計畫中的防禦戰轉成沿南高加索道路的進攻。納赫奇萬與耶爾溫相繼落入俄軍控制後，耶爾溫汗國的地方軍政中樞失去原有運作能力；城防、軍械庫與道路節點被俄軍接管，亞塞拜然方向原有的邊境屏障也因阿斯蘭迪的失敗而向後移動。俄軍由此獲得更接近波斯西北部的前進基地，但勝利同時製造了更長的縱深：從梯菲斯到耶爾溫的補給鏈約六百五十至七百公里，必須越過多段山道，砲兵、彈藥車和傷員後送都受到道路限制。俄軍在十二月底取得耶爾溫後選擇鞏固既有據點，而非把遠征繼續拉長，這使波斯得以重新調集兵力，而不是在阿斯蘭迪後立即崩潰。喬治亞分遣隊在戰役中與俄軍共同作戰，之後也更直接地納入南高加索軍事秩序；索羅門二世雖保留王號，其軍隊與行政卻更深地依賴俄方。波斯方面沒有接受阿斯蘭迪與兩城失守所帶來的結果，法塔利沙仍保有中央軍隊與再部署能力，戰事因而在1805年、1806年及1812年至1813年的新階段繼續。1804年真正改變的是主動權、邊界位置與後勤方向，而不是波斯國家的立即瓦解。
impactEn: The first change in 1804 was control of the theater. After Aslandı, the Persian expeditionary army was expelled from Kakheti, allowing Tsitsianov to convert a defensive operation into an advance along the Transcaucasian roads. The fall of Nakhchivan and Yerevan disrupted the military and administrative center of the Erivan Khanate. Fortifications, arsenals, and road junctions came under Russian control, and the buffer toward Azerbaijan was pushed backward following the Persian defeat. The Russians gained a forward base closer to the northwest of Persia, but the victory also created a much longer line of communication. The supply route from Tiflis to Yerevan extended roughly 650 to 700 kilometres across several difficult stages, with roads restricting the movement of artillery, ammunition wagons, and the column of wounded. After taking Yerevan in late December, the Russians consolidated the sites already acquired rather than extending the expedition farther, giving Persia time to rebuild and redeploy instead of collapsing immediately after Aslandı. The Georgian detachments fought alongside Russia and were then drawn more directly into the Transcaucasian military order. Solomon II retained his royal title, but his troops and administration became more dependent on Russia. Persia did not accept the combination of the defeat at Aslandı and the loss of Nakhchivan and Yerevan. Fath-Ali Shah retained the central forces needed for another effort, and the war continued through new phases in 1805, 1806, and 1812–1813. What changed in 1804 was therefore the initiative, the position of the frontier, and the direction of the logistical burden, rather than the immediate collapse of the Qajar state.
result: 到1804年12月26日，這一年度的戰役已有三項可以確定的結果。第一，阿斯蘭迪由俄軍取勝，波斯主力失去在卡赫季繼續作戰的能力，先鋒、主隊與輜重被切斷。第二，俄軍把戰果轉化為城市控制，依次接收納赫奇萬與耶爾溫的防務、軍械和道路節點，波斯在西北高加索的原有前沿退到更南的地區。第三，俄軍取得戰略主動權，卻因冬季、漫長補給線與兵力限制而未能把1804年的推進擴展為對波斯本土的決定性征服。俄羅斯與卡札爾波斯沒有在1804年簽訂和約，這一年度的結束只是戰役階段的界線；其後戰爭仍以另一輪進攻、反攻和談判延續，直到1813年10月24日簽訂《古爾斯坦條約》，俄方才取得達吉斯坦、東喬治亞與亞塞拜然的大部分地區。因而，1804年的正確結論是俄國在阿斯蘭迪取得戰術勝利、在南高加索取得作戰與戰略主動權，但整場俄波戰爭的最終領土結果要到1813年才確定；任何精確傷亡數字若缺乏一致史料，都不應被寫入這份戰役記錄。
resultEn: By 26 December 1804, three results of that year's campaign could be stated with certainty. First, Russia won the Battle of Aslandı, the Persian main force lost the ability to continue fighting in Kakheti, and its vanguard, center, and baggage were separated. Second, the Russians converted the battlefield success into control of strategic towns. They took over the defenses, arsenals, and road junctions of Nakhchivan and Yerevan in turn, while Persia's former northern frontier in the Transcaucasus moved farther south. Third, Russia gained the strategic initiative, but winter conditions, long supply routes, and limited numbers of troops prevented the advance of 1804 from becoming a decisive conquest of Persian territory. Russia and Qajar Persia signed no peace in 1804, so the end of that year marks only the close of a campaign phase. The war continued through further offensives, counteroffensives, and negotiations until the Treaty of Gulistan was signed on 24 October 1813, when Russia obtained Dagestan, eastern Georgia, and most of Azerbaijan. The accurate conclusion for 1804 is therefore a Russian tactical victory at Aslandı and operational and strategic initiative in the Transcaucasus, not the final territorial settlement of the entire Russo-Persian War. No precise casualty total should be entered into this account unless a consistent source can support it.
